description: This file defines the PdfFontTable class, which manages font resources within a PDF document in the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for retrieving or creating font objects based on type and typeface, and for computing font resource keys.

classes.name: PdfFontTable
classes.description: Manages font resources used in a PDF document, allowing retrieval and creation of font objects based on font type and typeface.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFont
methods.description: Retrieves an existing PdfFont corresponding to the given glyph typeface and font type; creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Intended to retrieve a PdfFont from font data, currently contains placeholder code and is not functional.

methods.name: TryGetFont
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a PdfFont by its identifier name; returns null if not found.

methods.name: ComputePdfFontKey
methods.description: Computes a unique key string for a font based on its typeface properties and font type, used for resource identification.
